pipeline_name: National Fuel Gas Supply Corporation Gas Pipeline

validity.recommendation: Status should be corrected from proposed to construction with Fall 2026 in-service target
validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline exists and is correctly classified as transmission. Specifications (capacity 190 MMcf/d, cost ~$100M, length ~23.5 mi total including 4 mi replacement section) confirmed via EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects (Aug 2026 release) and National Fuel's official project page. Status differs: sheet shows proposed, but EIA May 2026 onward shows Construction status, with National Fuel website confirming construction to begin June 2026 and in-service target Fall 2026. Route geometry (197-point LineString, approximately 19.8 mi straight-line distance from northwest Potter/Tioga County to southeast Lycoming/Clinton County, PA) aligns with project scope. Entity confirmed as National Fuel Gas Supply Corp (PA intrastate affiliate, distinct from sibling Empire Pipeline Inc of NY). Operator and Owner correctly identified.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sheet shows 'proposed' (updated 2025-10-14). Evidence of construction status is dated 2026-05: EIA May 2026 release (and all subsequent August 2026) shows Status='Construction'. National Fuel website (dated 2026) confirms 'construction is scheduled to begin in June 2026 with a target in-service date in Fall 2026.' This project has moved from 'Applied' status (Oct 2024 - Jan 2026) to 'Construction' status (May 2026 onward) with FERC approval (CPCN 5/5/2025 per EIA notes) and Notice to Proceed (January 2026). The sheet's 'proposed' status is stale as of May 2026 when transition to construction was documented.

summary: P7827 exists and is correctly classified as transmission; real pipeline under construction (not proposed). Specifications confirmed via EIA Aug 2026 and National Fuel website: 190 MMcf/d capacity, ~23.5 mi total (19.5 new + 4 replacement), 20-inch new + 12-inch replacement, $100-101M cost, June 2026 construction start, Fall 2026 in-service target. Operator/Owner correctly identified as National Fuel Gas Supply Corp (PA affiliate). Status should be corrected from proposed to construction; evidence dated 2026-05 onward.
